vectors.name: folder/layout-and-segment-rotation
vectors.description: A folder with a slot, a wrap and records. Alice's chain: two records of about 32 KiB take the first segment past 64 KiB, so seq 5 starts a new segment named by its seq. Reading back lists records per segment in file order.

vectors.name: folder/segment-partial-length
vectors.description: A final frame with only two of its four length bytes: ignored.

vectors.name: folder/segment-length-only
vectors.description: A final frame with its length and none of its body: ignored.

vectors.name: folder/segment-short-body
vectors.description: A final frame with part of its body: ignored.

vectors.name: folder/segment-zero-length-frame
vectors.description: A zero-length frame is a complete (and useless) frame, not an incomplete one.
